title: mri_mask
description: Applies a mask volume (typically skull stripped)

xform.description: Apply M3Z/LTA to transform mask to the space of input volume (identity.nofile possible, will invert if needed)
xform.title: Transformation

lta_src.description: Source volume for -xform (if not available from the xform file)
lta_src.title: LTA Source

lta_dst.description: Destination volume for -xform (if not available from the xform file)
lta_dst.title: LTA Destination

threshold.description: Threshold mask volume at a given threshold (values <= threshold considered zero)
threshold.title: Threshold

npad.description: Create a bounding box around the mask expanded by npad voxels in each direction
npad.title: Bounding Box Padding

npad_vector.description: Create a bounding box around the mask expanded by npad1 npad2 npad3 voxels in each direction
npad_vector.title: Bounding Box Padding Vector

npad_multi_vector.description: Create a bounding box around the mask, expanded by npad1a npad1b npad2a npad2b npad3a npad3b in each direction
npad_multi_vector.title: Bounding Box Full Padding Vector

abs.description: Take absolute value before applying threshold
abs.title: Absolute Flag

rh_labels.description: Set mask in right hemisphere labels to 1 (assumes input mask is an aseg)
rh_labels.title: Right Hemisphere Label Flag

lh_labels.description: Set mask in left hemisphere labels to 1 (assumes input mask is an aseg)
lh_labels.title: Left Hemisphere Label Flag

dilate.description: Dilate mask N times before applying
dilate.title: Dilate Mask

no_cerebellum.description: Remove cerebellum from aseg mask (assumes input mask is an aseg)
no_cerebellum.title: No Cerebellum Flag

oval_value.description: Use specified oval value as output instead of 0
oval_value.title: Oval Value

transfer_value.description: Transfer only the specified voxel value from mask to output
transfer_value.title: Transfer Value

keep_mask_deletion_edits.description: Transfer voxel-deletion edits (voxels=1) from mask to output volume
keep_mask_deletion_edits.title: Keep Mask Deletion Edits Flag

samseg.description: Assume mask is a SAMSEG segmentation and mask all non-brain labels
samseg.title: SAMSEG Segmentation Flag
